Loomwright Studio · Integrations mockup (phase 6)

The Integrations screen and its Connect GitHub sheet. Click through, use the keyboard, or force a view from the strip below or the URL hash. Nothing here talks to a real kernel; only the token-page link leaves the page.

Keys: ⌘K or / palette · ⌘5 Integrations (in a browser tab ⌘ switches tabs first; use ⌃5, and ⌃K) · J/K rows · ⏎ connect from the token field · Esc closes. URL hash: #view=<view>&theme=<light|dark|system>. In the sheet, a token starting github_pat_ connects, one containing write is refused as write-scoped, anything else is refused as invalid.
